# case: does the PIX numbering pass still fail on a /Od + debug-info shader with a subroutine?
# harness: run-pix-passes.py --history (committed beside this file)
# why not `triage.py bisect`: the symptom is a failure inside a PIX pass, reached through
#   IDxcOptimizer::RunOptimizer over an already-compiled module. `cmd.txt` holds one dxc
#   invocation, so the harness cannot express stage 2 and there is no match.json to bisect.
# repro: repro.hlsl -- AGENT-CONSTRUCTED. The reported repro is a private shader behind an
#   internal bug number and is not available; see notes.md.
# symptom: stage 2 does not complete, on a stage-1 module that is itself verifier-clean.
# controls: per build, `baseline` (same module, no passes) must SUCCEED and `control` (same
#   module with inlinedAt: deleted from one lexical-block-scoped DILocation, no passes) must
#   FAIL. Together they show the module went in clean and that the build still performs the
#   "!dbg attachment points at wrong subprogram" check.
# ran: 2026-08-07
# verdict: unscored
#
# Trimmed to the summary table, the three builds that carry the transition, and the verifier

# harness for the full output.
